# Gallagher Malpractice

> Gallagher Healthcare provides comprehensive medical malpractice insurance solutions for physicians, hospitals, and healthcare providers across the United States.

Gallagher Malpractice is part of Arthur J. Gallagher & Co., a global insurance brokerage firm. The site offers state-specific medical malpractice insurance guidance, risk management resources, and personalized quote requests for healthcare professionals seeking professional liability coverage.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice Insurance
- Physician Coverage
- Insurance Requirements
- Tail Coverage

- Physician Protection
- Healthcare Providers

- Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
- CORE360
- The Gallagher Way

- [Idaho Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/idaho-medical-malpractice-insurance): Idaho medical malpractice insurance overview and physician coverage guide
- [Montana Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/montana-medical-malpractice-insurance): Montana medical malpractice insurance requirements and coverage overview
- [Nevada Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/nevada-medical-malpractice-insurance): Nevada medical malpractice insurance requirements and physician coverage
- [New Mexico Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/new-mexico-medical-malpractice-insurance): New Mexico medical malpractice insurance and Medical Review Commission guide
- [Oregon Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/oregon-medical-malpractice-insurance): Oregon medical malpractice insurance requirements and coverage overview
- [Utah Medical Malpractice Insurance](https://www.gallaghermalpractice.com/state-resources/utah-medical-malpractice-insurance): Utah Health Care Malpractice Act insurance requirements and coverage guide
